name: 3-Pass Texture Mapping with Compositing
aliases: 3-pass version of 2-pass texture mapping with compositing
definition: A technique for speeding up geometric transformations of volume data by combining a 3-pass version of 2-pass texture mapping with compositing, where the image generation problem is simplified to geometrically transforming two values per voxel and compositing the results.
summary: 3-Pass Texture Mapping with Compositing accelerates volume rendering by pre-computing color and opacity, then re-sampling separately in three orthogonal directions to reduce computational expense.
